title: Flow evidence
description: The flow evidence, as defined in The Software Field Guide, issue #80: the flows observed during a named audit window, aggregated per from/to/type/port tuple. This is the file a promotion PR cites (promotion is evidence, not assertion) and the substrate the dead-rule review reads — a rule that matched zero flows across the window is a rule nobody exercised, and it gets the review flag rather than silence. The validator additionally enforces the semantic rules a JSON schema cannot: the window real and not in the future, the evidence fresh (reviewed within 365 days), and the counts positive integers.

reviewedOn.description: Date the evidence was last reviewed, YYYY-MM-DD. Evidence has a shelf life — stale flow evidence says nothing about the estate rendering today.

window.description: The audit window the flows were observed in. Observed flows without the window that observed them are evidence about no time at all; the window may not end in the future.

from.description: The day the window opened, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The day the window closed, YYYY-MM-DD. Not after today — evidence cannot cover the future.

flows.description: The observed flows, aggregated per from/to/type/port tuple. A flow matches the contract rule with the same tuple; a rule with zero matched flows across the window is flagged for review.

type.description: The protocol, inside the modeled subset.

count.description: The observed flow count for this tuple across the window.
